PockPock Agent 0.2.0 has a new look, five themes, and keeps itself up to date.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.1.0?** Download and install 0.2.0 once, the same way as the first time. Your chats, settings and models are kept. From 0.2.0 on, PockPock updates itself on Windows.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new

- **A new look.** The PockPock mark, a chicken foot whose centre toe is a lightning bolt, is the app icon and sits in the title bar.
- **You can always see it working.** While an agent thinks, plans or runs a tool, the mark's bolt pulses next to what it is doing, with a running timer, and a thin bar sweeps across the message box.
- **Five themes.** **Settings → Theme**: **PockPock Dark** (the default), **Volt** and **Storm** in the brand's colours, **Feather** for light mode, and **System**, which follows your computer. Every theme meets WCAG AA contrast, and PockPock opens straight in the theme you chose.
- **Automatic updates (Windows).** New versions download in the background and install when you press **Restart to update** or quit PockPock. You can switch automatic downloads off in **Settings → Updates**. On a Mac, PockPock tells you when a new version is out and links to it.
- **Easier to read and use.** Buttons, text fields and the message box have stronger contrast in PockPock Dark, focus is easier to see, and the terminal's colours are readable in every theme.

## Good to know

- After an update, the first start can take a little longer while PockPock updates its services.
- The Mac versions have not been tested on a real Mac yet. Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
